tagline: Pleasing People, One Guest at a Time
hero_kpi_rationale: Key indicator of organic growth in established restaurants, reflecting the performance of mature stores excluding new locations and measured over comparable calendar weeks

kpis.name: Comparable store restaurant sales increase
kpis.explanation: Sales increase in retail stores that have been open for at least six quarters, measured over comparable calendar weeks
kpis.description: Indicator of sales growth in established restaurants, measured over comparable calendar weeks. Calculated by dividing the change in absolute dollar sales by prior year comparable store sales

kpis.name: Comparable store retail sales increase
kpis.explanation: Sales increase in retail stores that have been open for at least six quarters, measured over comparable calendar weeks
kpis.description: Indicator of sales growth in established retail stores, measured over comparable calendar weeks. Calculated by dividing the change in absolute dollar sales by prior year comparable store sales

kpis.name: Average check increase per guest
kpis.explanation: Increase in the average amount spent per customer in comparable restaurants, expressed as a percentage change
kpis.description: Measure of changes in average basket size in comparable restaurants. Calculated by dividing comparable restaurant sales by comparable customer traffic, then comparing with the prior period and expressing the change as a percentage

kpis.name: Comparable restaurant guest traffic increase
kpis.explanation: Increase in the number of customers (covers) sold in comparable restaurants that have been open for at least six quarters
kpis.description: Indicator of customer traffic growth, measured by the number of covers sold in dine-in and off-premise sales in comparable stores. Calculated by dividing the absolute change in number of covers by the total number of covers from the historical period, expressed as a percentage

kpis.name: Impact of tariffs on results
kpis.explanation: Impact of tariffs on company results in Q4 2025
kpis.description: The company recorded a negative impact of approximately 2.4 million dollars related to new tariffs imposed in Q4 2025, partially offset by supplier negotiations, alternative sourcing, pricing adjustments and SKU reductions. The company expects to substantially offset the tariff impact in 2026

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company is aware of persistent cybersecurity threats and has developed a structured risk management program based on NIST CSF, but acknowledges that incidents could still occur and cause material harm

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to regulations, including data protection, credit card payment and food industry standards compliance

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The restaurant industry is highly competitive with several overlapping segments (family, casual, quick service). CBRL operates primarily in full-service dining and must maintain its position against national and regional competitors

risks.title: Litigation
risks.score_rationale: The company is party to legal and regulatory proceedings, but these are not expected to have a material impact on results

risks.title: Key person
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on its management and key employees for its success and the implementation of its multi-year strategy

risks.title: Macroeconomic conditions and inflation
risks.score_rationale: The company identifies significant macroeconomic challenges including inflation volatility, elevated interest rates, increased consumer debt and reduced savings. These conditions directly affect discretionary income and consumption habits in the cyclical restaurant sector

risks.title: Weather conditions and climate change
risks.score_rationale: Severe weather events (storms, floods, droughts) can impact operations, supply chains and customer visits. Climate change increases the incidence of these disruptions

risks.title: Tariffs and trade policy
risks.score_rationale: The company recorded an impact of 2.4M$ in Q4 2025 related to new tariffs. Any additional changes to tariffs or trade policy could materially affect operating results and financial condition

ai_positioning.summary: The company has not mentioned artificial intelligence, machine learning or similar technologies as major strategic areas in its filing documents. While certain digital initiatives include the use of advanced technologies (e.g. loyalty program with personalized offers), AI is not positioned as a core element of the company's business strategy
